title: Spend Benchmark Agent
tagline: Ask plain-English questions about Umeå kommun's 2025 supplier invoices: 383,902 invoice lines, about SEK 5.9 billion, by department, supplier, account and month. Every number is computed by a tool on the real data, never guessed, and you can see each calculation.

Server-side aggregation of the 383,902 invoice lines of 2025 (catalog record count) by month, department, supplier and account text; belopp is the summed amount in SEK excluding VAT, antal_rader the number of invoice lines.
Some supplier names are masked with asterisks; the catalog description of an earlier year says some data is hidden under GDPR.
datum is the posting month as an integer YYYYMM, not a date.

tools.name: spend_by_account
tools.description: Rank account categories (konto_text) by spend or invoice-line count, optionally within one department, month or supplier. Data: Umeå kommun supplier invoices 2025 summed per month (datum, YYYYMM), department (forvaltning), supplier (leverantor) and account text (konto_text). belopp is SEK excluding VAT; antal_rader is the number of invoice lines. Use agg='sum' for totals: 'mean' and 'median' describe month-department-supplier-account cells, not invoices. The 'rows' in the result are cells, so sum antal_rader to count invoice lines.

params.eval_question: Which account had the highest total spend in Teknisk nämnd in 2025?

tools.name: spend_by_supplier
tools.description: Rank suppliers (leverantor) by spend or invoice-line count, optionally within one account, department or month. Returns the top 50; use it to find exact supplier names and to measure supplier concentration in an account. Data: Umeå kommun supplier invoices 2025 summed per month (datum, YYYYMM), department (forvaltning), supplier (leverantor) and account text (konto_text). belopp is SEK excluding VAT; antal_rader is the number of invoice lines. Use agg='sum' for totals: 'mean' and 'median' describe month-department-supplier-account cells, not invoices. The 'rows' in the result are cells, so sum antal_rader to count invoice lines.

params.eval_question: Which supplier received the most food (Livsmedel) spend in 2025?

tools.name: spend_by_department
tools.description: Compare departments (forvaltning) on spend or invoice-line count, optionally within one account, supplier or month. This is the peer benchmark: one department against the others. Data: Umeå kommun supplier invoices 2025 summed per month (datum, YYYYMM), department (forvaltning), supplier (leverantor) and account text (konto_text). belopp is SEK excluding VAT; antal_rader is the number of invoice lines. Use agg='sum' for totals: 'mean' and 'median' describe month-department-supplier-account cells, not invoices. The 'rows' in the result are cells, so sum antal_rader to count invoice lines.

params.eval_question: Which department spent the most on food (Livsmedel) in 2025?

tools.name: spend_by_month
tools.description: Monthly spend or invoice-line count for 2025 (group = datum, YYYYMM), optionally within one department, account or supplier. Results are sorted by value, not by month. Data: Umeå kommun supplier invoices 2025 summed per month (datum, YYYYMM), department (forvaltning), supplier (leverantor) and account text (konto_text). belopp is SEK excluding VAT; antal_rader is the number of invoice lines. Use agg='sum' for totals: 'mean' and 'median' describe month-department-supplier-account cells, not invoices. The 'rows' in the result are cells, so sum antal_rader to count invoice lines.

params.eval_question: In which month of 2025 was rent (Lokalhyra) spend highest?

tools.name: invoice_size_by_account
tools.description: Invoice-line size benchmark per account (konto_text): median, mean, min, max, sum or count of belopp, optionally within one department. Compare median with mean to show skew, and report the 'rows' behind each figure. Data: individual supplier invoice lines of Umeå kommun for September 2025 only. belopp is SEK excluding VAT per line; negative values are credits.

params.eval_question: Which account has the highest median invoice line in Äldrenämnd in September 2025?

tools.name: find_invoice_lines
tools.description: List individual invoice lines, filtered by department, account or supplier and sorted by any returned column (for example the largest lines by belopp). Use it to show the evidence behind a figure. Data: individual supplier invoice lines of Umeå kommun for September 2025 only. belopp is SEK excluding VAT per line; negative values are credits.

params.eval_question: How many food (Livsmedel) invoice lines are there in September 2025?

example_questions: Which accounts did Umeå kommun spend the most on in 2025, and how many invoice lines are behind each figure?
